title: SAP Emarsys - Complex onboarding and steep learning curve
clean_text: Users report that initial setup of SAP Emarsys is complicated, with a steep learning curve that requires formal training to operate effectively. Enterprise Edition's value depends heavily on having a mature SAP CX deployment; companies without sufficient SAP infrastructure end up paying 2 to 3 times the price for integration capabilities they never use. Most companies activate only 5 to 10 of the 60+ pre-built tactics, leaving significant platform value unused. Small ecommerce brands with fewer than 20,000 contacts are considered over-served by the platform relative to its cost.
